description:
Lists the instruments of the corporate issuers in the registry (convertible notes, credit facilities, bonds, perpetual preferreds), one row per instrument, as the site's /instruments pages show them: terms, seniority, the yield a holder receives where a last regular-session trade prices it, returns, and the issuer's bitcoin holdings. The holding is the latest-dated figure read from a filing; btc_holdings_derived, beside it, is the last read plus the purchases filed since ("derived from filed purchases"), display only, never in backing_ratio, and confirmed or corrected by the next read. Corporate lending, not bitcoin-backed credit: a holder lends to the issuer with no lien on its bitcoin, except where the issuer has pledged bitcoin against a facility.

btc_backing also carries the debt attributed to bitcoin, beside the filed debt: for each company holding at least 100 BTC (a subsidiary counted at its parent), bitcoin-pledged debt counts in full (no more than the pledged coins' value where the line states them), debt secured by other assets at zero, and unsecured debt and preferred stock at the company's unencumbered share of assets. It is a stated convention applied to filed figures, not a measurement; total assets, each debt line and its security are served beside it, and a company whose figure cannot be attributed says why. Income in the returns is what the terms accrue, not what was confirmed paid (returns_convention says so). Prices are IEX's, credited in the answer's attribution. Returns the route's payload as served.

Standard questions this tool answers (get_guide with question): SQ-Co1.
name: get_corporate_instruments
title: Corporate instruments (preferreds and debt)
